name: StaticSave MCP Server
description: Hosted StaticSave MCP server at https://mcp.staticsave.com. Hosts static files, module folders, and Base64 images with instant global CDN delivery. Mutations are create_file, update_file, delete_file, create_folder, delete_folder; inspections are list_files, list_folders, get_account_info. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: create_file rejects duplicate filenames to prevent accidental overwrites; inspect existing assets first via list_files and their public CDN URLs before calling update_file.
Use create_temporary_file to preview or test assets with a 24-hour auto-expiry before writing permanent production assets.
Keep delete_folder and delete_file on Block or Review unless unattended asset removal is explicitly intended.
